verdict.rationale: Poly documents a 'flashback mode' that shows exactly what files looked like at any past point, down to the millisecond. Its recovering-files docs say conflicting edits are preserved so you can 'recover any version of any file at any time'. Notes such as journal entries are stored as Markdown files, so this history applies to them. Missing for 10: an explicit deleted-file/trash recovery flow, detail on the restore UI or CLI workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
